_description: Expected results for Laravel/Cloudflare: XSRF-TOKEN must NOT alone trigger a high-confidence Laravel detection. Server 'cloudflare' must NOT trigger version disclosure.

must_not_detect.rationale: FP regression: Server header 'cloudflare' is a CDN banner, NOT a version string. Must not be flagged.

FP regression: XSRF-TOKEN alone is insufficient evidence for high-confidence Laravel detection. Many frameworks use CSRF tokens with similar names. Confidence must remain below 60 for XSRF-TOKEN-only detection.
